scope: Focused review of the Alaska election calls, incoming congressional oversight, Iran operations, Lisa Cook’s hearing, chip enforcement, Ukraine military assistance and U.S.–Thailand trade talks. The Alaska final count, House leadership votes, homeland security hearing, Venezuela election agreement and several court and diplomatic outcomes remain open.
summary: The Associated Press called Alaska’s Senate race for Mary Peltola, bringing the projected Democratic majority to 56 seats. Representative Robert Garcia asked officials to keep records for incoming House inquiries. The United States and Iran exchanged strikes while Qatar and Oman continued contacts. Lisa Cook challenged the terms of her White House hearing. Three House committees scheduled interviews with Nvidia’s former chief executive and its top lawyer, and British and German officials disputed Pentagon advice on Ukraine. Alaska’s final count, House leadership results, the homeland security hearing, Venezuela’s election agreement and several court and diplomatic outcomes remain open.
editorial_notes: Read changed headlines on their own and clarified the Thai trade announcement, the chip investigation, the Qeshm strike and Garcia’s records targets. The second pass distinguishes a preservation request from production, a race call from certification, and a hearing plan from testimony. Existing scenario labels and forecast history were preserved.

validation_results.result: Changed event rows, linked assessments, forecasts and reviewed public prose checked together.
repairs: Added decision-specific explanations for events without faction scores.

major_developments.finding: Associated Press calls Alaska’s Senate race for Mary Peltola, projecting 56 Democratic seats
major_developments.reason: An additional Democratic senator increases the majority’s room to manage ordinary Senate business. With all senators present, conviction would still require at least 11 Republican votes if all 56 Democrats voted to convict.

major_developments.finding: Representative Robert Garcia asks Vance and other Trump officials to keep records for House inquiries
major_developments.reason: Garcia is identifying witnesses and records before Democrats are expected to control the committee. His letters can help frame hearings and later subpoenas. They establish neither compelled production nor findings of misconduct.

major_developments.finding: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook declines White House removal hearing unless procedures change
major_developments.reason: Cook is contesting the procedure while the court order from the earlier removal effort keeps her in office. Trump’s committee can press ahead, but the hearing dispute leaves any final removal and its legal durability open.

major_developments.finding: U.S. strikes missile site on Iran’s Qeshm Island after Iran targets a radar installation in Bahrain
major_developments.reason: The exchange shows Washington used military force while Gulf mediators kept talking. It leaves open whether the United States will carry out further strikes or give mediators terms for a settlement.

major_developments.finding: Iran targets an air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain after the U.S. strike on Qeshm
major_developments.reason: The attacks put protection of Gulf bases back before the Pentagon and its regional partners. They are separate from the March attack that prompted a congressional request for records on troop protection.

major_developments.finding: Commerce and Justice describe their chip investigation as Representative Brian Mast asks for records
major_developments.reason: The agencies have offered a timeline that Congress can test against records of licenses, inspections and referrals. The statement leaves the scale of any diversion and individual responsibility open.

major_developments.finding: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and company lawyer Tim Teter agree to House interviews
major_developments.reason: Lawmakers can question the former executive and company counsel about decisions and records. An agreed interview does not establish attendance, answers or a finding of wrongdoing.

major_developments.finding: Pentagon official Elbridge Colby urges Ukraine’s backers to prioritize front-line equipment
major_developments.reason: The public disagreement shows Britain and Germany are willing to dispute U.S. advice in the group that coordinates arms for Ukraine. Future pledges and deliveries will show whether they act on that disagreement.

major_developments.finding: Trump and Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul say trade talks are nearly complete
major_developments.reason: The announcement gives the two governments a basis to finish the agreement. Actual changes to import duties or access depend on final terms and implementation.

assessments/current.reader_takeaway: The Alaska call clarifies the next Senate majority, and Garcia is preparing specific inquiries.
assessments/current.context_check: Identified Garcia’s committee, the recipients, the decision on Cook’s hearing and where Iran struck.
assessments/current.uncertainty_check: Projected chamber control, reported military operations, anticipated testimony and possible changes in primary support remain qualified.
changes_made: Identified the committee and explained how a records request could expose Vance to questions about his own role.
Separated the latest threats to Gulf bases from the earlier fatal Kuwait attack.

assessments/issues.reader_takeaway: The new evidence changes several issue decisions, including who can question officials and what they can ask for.
assessments/issues.context_check: Explained records production, who supplies arms to Ukraine, who regulates chip sales and what is still open in Venezuela.
assessments/issues.uncertainty_check: Reported allegations, proposed inquiries and unverified implementation remain qualified.
changes_made: Replaced donor shorthand with governments supplying arms.
Distinguished a subpoena from receipt of records and named Stephen Miller and Marlin Stutzman.
Clarified the Venezuela timetable and chip investigation.

events/AI.reader_takeaway: Congress can test the government’s account of its Megaspeed investigation and has scheduled interviews with Nvidia witnesses.
events/AI.context_check: Named the company, lawmakers, officials and subject of the interviews.
events/AI.uncertainty_check: Attributed the enforcement timeline to the departments. Announced interviews and individual responsibility remain open.
changes_made: Clarified the investigation subject and what sales restrictions and potential chip diversion mean.

events/FED.reader_takeaway: Lisa Cook is challenging the process of the hearing on her removal and remains in office.
events/FED.context_check: Named the governor, lawyer, White House counsel and the hearing’s purpose.
events/FED.uncertainty_check: Separated the reported hearing date and counsel’s position from a possible committee action or court ruling.
changes_made: Explained the earlier court order, the possibility the panel proceeds without Cook and potential litigation.

events/IRN.reader_takeaway: The United States and Iran exchanged strikes while Gulf mediators kept talking.
events/IRN.context_check: Specified Qeshm Island and distinguished the Bahrain radar incident from the following attacks in Kuwait and Bahrain.
events/IRN.uncertainty_check: Identified the anonymously sourced U.S. account, Bahrain’s interception claim and limits on damage reporting.
changes_made: Named Qeshm in the headline and expanded attribution for the later attacks.

events/MID.reader_takeaway: Alaska’s call adds a projected Democratic senator and Garcia has sought records for planned inquiries.
events/MID.context_check: Identified the committee, the races, the requests and the affected officials.
events/MID.uncertainty_check: Race calls remain projections, and requests are distinct from subpoenas, production and findings.
changes_made: Explained which House committee Garcia serves on and what the Epstein and Maxwell requests concern.

events/RUS.reader_takeaway: Britain and Germany publicly disputed U.S. advice to prioritize front-line equipment for Ukraine.
events/RUS.context_check: Named the U.S., British and German officials and explained what forum they addressed.
events/RUS.uncertainty_check: Their public positions do not establish a change in pledges or deliveries.
changes_made: Explained what the Brussels group does and named Russian forces as the subject of Colby’s argument.

events/TAR.reader_takeaway: The United States and Thailand say their trade talks are nearing completion.
events/TAR.context_check: Named both leaders and the negotiations.
events/TAR.uncertainty_check: The official announcement covers progress in talks. Signed operative terms and implementation remain open.
changes_made: Replaced an abstract headline with the announced state of trade talks.

impeachments/all.reader_takeaway: Oversight requests and a projected extra Senate seat warrant monitoring across cases, while the case estimates hold.
impeachments/all.context_check: Explained the vote arithmetic, what records would matter and why a former official’s case remains open.
impeachments/all.uncertainty_check: Separated referrals, evidence requests, actual conviction and conditional projections.
changes_made: Rewrote five case watches, distinguished the two Guilfoyle requests, and clarified the Senate pathways and individual holds.
Replaced shorthand source descriptions with descriptions naming the actor and action.

nominations/republican_2028.reader_takeaway: The new sources document a line of inquiry into Vance’s role and renewed attacks relevant to the primary debate.
nominations/republican_2028.context_check: Explained the actors and why the overseas operations and congressional requests matter.
nominations/republican_2028.uncertainty_check: Retained reporting attributions and recorded the limits on observed response while weekly odds carry forward.
changes_made: Clarified descriptions of the Alaska projection, Garcia’s requests and Reuters’s anonymously attributed account.

runs/2026-11-18.context_check: Identified the committee interviews and the subjects of the focused review.
